beats: Vishnu meditated in the Himalayan cold
Lakshmi sheltered him as a badri tree
Nar and Narayan kept penance here

beats.line: Vishnu sits in deep meditation amid the snows
Lakshmi becomes a badri tree to shelter him
Twin peaks Nar and Narayan keep their penance
Pilgrims bathe at Tapt Kund by the Alaknanda
